Post-receipt clarification

After the immutable `88c90f8b5abf4a80be3b1289d7719d6e03e29684` audit was written, `origin/main` advanced to `6e3c3571dd5b4f82a0faf55ac4b3f3a44401b708`. The sole intervening code path is `infra/terraform/variables.tf`; it has zero overlap with the 45 unique file-impact paths repaired here. The immutable prose inventories and stored commands therefore remain valid.

Operation-count correction: the repair performed exactly 13 planning mutations before the ledger comment, and that count already includes the `discovered_from` link: nine updates across the three existing leaves, then create + impact + verify + link for the new leaf. The earlier phrase “13 leaf mutations plus ... link” double-counted that link. All 13 returned `push_status.state=ok`.
